# Merchendice

> Merchendice is a merch studio for creators and influencers of any size on TikTok, Instagram and YouTube. We design every piece from a creator’s own content and colours, so the designs are exclusive to them. Then we build and run the store. Each order is printed on demand and shipped for them, so they never touch stock. Based and designed in Sweden.

## Who it is for

Creators of any size, on any platform.

## What can be sold

Clothing, totes and bags, mugs, home goods like pillows and blankets, and jewellery.

## How to get started

Send the enquiry form and we reply by email, usually within one or two days. There’s nothing to pay while we shape the idea and the designs. You only pay once your store is ready to launch. Commercial terms are agreed with you before any work begins. A store is usually live in 2 to 3 weeks.
